summary: Tested the real_enforce_guard OR-logic fix and the frontend auto-fill on 4 pages. I created temporary users scoped to a department or a faculty, then cleaned them up through the API. Backend: 34 of 37 pytest cases pass. Cases (a), (b) and (c) from the request all behave correctly, and admin, Saeed and Salim are unaffected on 6 endpoints (18/18 pass). Two security problems were found. (1) NEW, caused by the fix: GET /api/teachers with own department_id + parent faculty_id now gives a department-only user teachers outside their department. (2) Already existed and the fix leaves it open: a faculty-scoped user can send a department_id from another faculty together with their own faculty_id. The guard accepts this, and /teaching-load/report/advanced then returns the other department's full report (confirmed: 3 teachers, same as admin). /faculty-board/candidates and /faculty-board/decisions accept the same request (200) and filter by department_id only; no leak was seen there only because the target department has no candidates or decisions. Frontend: weekly-schedule auto-fill works only after in-app navigation, not after a full page load or refresh. report-teacher-workload auto-fill never runs. The alumni and faculty-board auto-fill code cannot be reached by a typical restricted user (role=employee) because the page gate blocks them first. Admin, Saeed and Salim pages show no regression.

critical.issue: Scope bypass. A user scoped to faculty A who sends department_id=<a department in faculty B> plus faculty_id=<faculty A> fails the department check but passes on the faculty_id fallback. These endpoints then filter by department_id only, so data from faculty B is returned. Reproduced: /teaching-load/report/advanced returned 200 with the department of another faculty (total_teachers=3, identical to admin). Sending the foreign department_id alone returns 403, as expected. This already happened before the fix (the old code checked faculty_id first), and the new OR logic does not close it.

Privilege widening introduced by this fix. A department-only user sending own department_id + parent faculty_id now passes the guard on the department check. The faculty branch then rewrites the filter to ALL departments of the faculty and sets department_id=None, and the cross-department teaching-load logic runs. Result: 13 teachers returned versus 12 for their own department; 1 leaked teacher is from department 698e501d... Before the fix this request returned 403.

minor.issue: A faculty-scoped user sending a foreign department_id + own faculty_id gets 200. The guard should reject this. Today it returns an empty result only because the query ANDs faculty_id and department_id.

ui_bugs.issue: Auto-fill does not run after a full page load or refresh (direct URL). The effect has [] deps and reads `user` from useAuth. AuthContext.loadStoredAuth sets `user` asynchronously, so `user` is still null when the effect runs and getMyScope returns restricted=false. After full page.goto('/weekly-schedule') no /departments call was made and the faculty picker stayed empty. With in-app (pushState) navigation it works: the faculty is pre-filled and GET /weekly-schedule?faculty_id&department_id returns 200.

Auto-fill never runs for restricted users. Promise.all([teachersAPI.getAll(), departmentsAPI.getAll(), facultiesAPI.getAll()]): teachersAPI.getAll() has no params and returns 400 for real-enforcement users, so the whole Promise.all rejects into a silent catch. The departments and faculties lists stay empty, setDept/setFac never run, and 'تنفيذ التقرير' then calls /reports/teacher-workload with no scope, gets 403 and redirects to /no-permission. Fix: use Promise.allSettled, or pass the scope to teachersAPI.getAll. The same stale `user` closure problem also applies (deps [isTeacher]).

Promise.all([departmentsAPI.getAll(), getRooms, getSettings]). When /rooms returns 403 for a restricted user, the whole effect fails and the departments list stays empty. The department picker then shows '-- الكل --' while selectedDept is silently set (confusing), and the badge reads 'كامل الكلية (0 قسم)'. Use allSettled.

integration_issues.issue: canManage = role in admin/dean/department_head. A real-enforcement user with role=employee (what quick-find-or-create creates) only sees 'هذه الصفحة مخصصة للإدارة فقط', so the new auto-fill code is never reached. In addition, on mount the second effect fires fetchCandidates and fetchSessions before the scope state updates, which would trigger a 400 alert for restricted users. Legacy users also get duplicate candidates/sessions/decisions requests (observed 2x each).

canView requires legacy VIEW_STUDENTS/MANAGE_STUDENTS. Real-enforcement users have permissions=[], so they are redirected to /no-permission even with alumni_alumni_list_alumni granted. The auto-fill could not be tested for a restricted user. Same stale `user` closure (deps [canView]).

action_items: Fix real_enforce_guard. When department_id is provided, check ONLY the department scope; real_enforce_check already falls back to the department's parent faculty. Use faculty_id only when department_id is absent. If both are sent, also reject when the department does not belong to faculty_id. This keeps case (a) working and closes the foreign-department bypass on teaching-load/report/advanced, faculty-board/candidates, faculty-board/decisions and weekly-schedule.

GET /api/teachers real-enforcement branch: do not widen to all faculty departments when department_id is provided. Keep department_id as the filter, or apply the faculty expansion only when the user actually holds faculty scope.
weekly-schedule, report-teacher-workload, alumni, faculty-board: make the auto-fill effects depend on `user` (or read cachedUser/localStorage) so the defaults apply after a page refresh.
report-teacher-workload: change Promise.all to Promise.allSettled, or call teachers with scope params, so the 400 from /teachers does not block auto-fill.
weekly-schedule faculty-change effect: use allSettled so a 403 from /rooms does not wipe the departments list.
faculty-board: allow real-enforcement users in canManage, otherwise the auto-fill is dead code. Gate the first fetch until the scope defaults are applied to avoid a 400 alert and duplicate requests.
alumni: allow real-enforcement users through the canView gate (backend guard already enforces).
critical_code_review_comments: real_enforce_guard OR semantics accept mismatched (department_id, faculty_id) pairs. Every caller that later prefers department_id in its query (faculty_board, teaching_load report) is exposed. The safer approach is to validate the most specific parameter.
getMyScope(user) is called inside effects whose deps do not include user, which gives stale closures.

success_rate.frontend: 50% (weekly-schedule auto-fill works after in-app navigation only; report-teacher-workload broken; alumni and faculty-board not reachable for restricted users; admin/legacy regression 100%)

seed_data_creation: Created TEST_deptonly161, TEST_faconly161, TEST_probe161, TEST_probefac161, TEST_uidept161 and TEST_uifac161, plus TEST_role_* roles. All assignments were ended via /advanced-access/assignments/{id}/end and all users deleted via DELETE /api/users/{id}; verified 0 left. The orphan TEST_role_* roles remain because there is no delete endpoint. Saeed, Salim and admin were not modified (real_enforcement stays False/None).

To compare refresh vs in-app navigation, navigate with history.pushState + popstate.
rca of the issue: Backend: guard = any(dept_ok, fac_ok), but endpoints filter by department_id first, so a passing faculty_id authorizes an arbitrary department_id. /teachers then expands faculty_id to all departments even when authorization came from the department check. Frontend: AuthContext sets user asynchronously from AsyncStorage, and the effects with [] or unrelated deps capture user=null. Promise.all fails as a whole on a single 400/403 from a sibling request.
